name: single-leg-good-morning
instructions:
1. Set a bar just below shoulder height in a rack and adjust the safeties to just above hip height.
2. Set your hands equidistant apart, step underneath, and position the bar on your traps (or slightly below if you prefer a low bar version).
3. Stand up tall and take two steps back from the rack.
4. Begin the movement by unlocking your knees, lifting one foot, and hinging back into the hips while keeping your spine neutral.
5. Drive through the whole foot as you extend the hip back to the starting position.
6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions on both sides.
